note: How the conformance tester drives radiopost-gateway. {bin} is the program, {home} a fresh directory for each gateway. `key` prints the gateway's public key (base64url or hex); `serve` runs until the tester ends it; `copies` makes it hold copies placed ahead (RP-5 §5.8), for the offline tests. For F-01 to F-06 (RP-7): `partner` names a partner; `window` gives it a window on a USB dial in MHz with Aether's bandwidth in hertz (one outside the country's segments may be refused); `register` registers it from an operator's client home holding `device.key` (the seed in hex) and `credential` (its bytes); `forward` has it call a partner now, as its operator may, and ends when the call does. In conformance mode it asks only the tester's DNS resolver, and reaches the test post office at the URL `post_office` gives it (the outline's §2.3).
